#!/bin/bash
# usage: sim.sh <check.json> <lines per page> <step per pagedown> <mutation jq on the paragraph list>
check=$1; n=$2; step=$3; mut=$4
defs=$(cat defs.jq)
until_expr=$(jq -r '.steps[2].do[-1].until' "$check")
expect_expr=$(jq -r '.steps[2].expect[1].that' "$check")
pagejs() { # $1 = first paragraph index
  jq -n -c --argjson s "$1" --argjson n "$n" "$defs"' (paragraphs | '"$mut"') as $p | ($p | last | .offset) as $len | ($p[:-1]) as $q
    | {json: {window: {}, sections: {notebook: {length: $len, folded: [], selection: {location: 0, length: 0}, scroll: {y: ($s * 16), height: ($n*16), documentHeight: (($q|length)*16)}, drawn: [$q[$s:$s+$n][] | . + {rect: {}}]}}}}'
}
max=$(( 203 - n )); [ $max -lt 0 ] && max=0
pos=0; rec=$(jq -n -c --argjson t "$(pagejs 0)" '{unfoldedTop: $t}')
for r in $(seq 1 200); do
  a=$(pagejs $pos); np=$(( pos + step )); [ $np -gt $max ] && np=$max; b=$(pagejs $np)
  rec=$(jq -c --argjson a "$a" --argjson b "$b" '. + {unfoldedPage: $a, unfoldedNext: $b}' <<<"$rec")
  if [ "$(jq "$until_expr" <<<"$rec")" = true ]; then echo "stopped after round $r"; break; fi
  pos=$np
done
echo "expect: $(jq "$expect_expr" <<<"$rec")"
EOF
